description.hr: Pravi drniški pršut, s bilim, ka šta i mora bit. Ko za bolje ne zna, ne zna šta propušta.
description.en: Real Drniš pršut with the proper white fat, just as it should be. If you haven't tried the real thing, you don't know what you're missing.

description.hr: Ovčji sir iz mišine, od lokalnih proizvođača.
description.en: Sheep's cheese aged in a traditional leather sack, from local producers.

description.hr: Zvijezda našeg menija — teleća koljenica s pečenim krumpirima, kiselim kupusom i zapečenom fažolom.
description.en: The star of our menu — veal knuckle with roast potatoes, sauerkraut, and baked beans.

description.hr: Domaće tripice, ka šta ih je baba radila. Na suvom mesu, na prasetini.
description.en: Homemade tripe stew, just like grandma used to make. Cooked with smoked pork, the traditional way.

description.hr: Domaći grah ili manistre s ječmom — klasika za radnog čovika.
description.en: Homemade bean stew or barley pasta — a classic that fuels working folk.

description.hr: Teletina ili janjetina s krumpirom, pečena ispod peke ka šta se radi oduvijek.
description.en: Veal or lamb with potatoes, slow-roasted under the iron bell the way it's always been done.

description.hr: Domaći ćevapi s lukom i kajmakom.
description.en: Homemade ćevapi with onions and kajmak cream.
Juicy meat skewers off the grill.
